zoom.description: The controlled zoom level of the image.

default-zoom.description: The initial zoom factor to apply to the image.

rotation.description: The controlled rotation of the image in degrees (0 - 360).

default-rotation.description: The initial rotation to apply to the image in degrees.

flip.description: The controlled flip state of the image.

default-flip.description: The initial flip state to apply to the image.

aspect-ratio.description:
The aspect ratio to maintain for the crop area (width / height).
For example, an aspect ratio of 16 / 9 will maintain a width to height ratio of 16:9.
If not provided, the crop area can be freely resized.

crop-shape.description: The shape of the crop area.

min-width.description: The minimum width of the crop area

min-height.description: The minimum height of the crop area

max-width.description: The maximum width of the crop area

max-height.description: The maximum height of the crop area

zoom-step.description: The amount of zoom applied per wheel step.

nudge-step.description: The base nudge step for keyboard arrow keys (in pixels).

nudge-step-shift.description: The nudge step when Shift key is held (in pixels).

nudge-step-ctrl.description: The nudge step when Ctrl/Cmd key is held (in pixels).

fixed-crop-area.description: Whether the crop area is fixed in size and position.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

zoomchange.description: Fired when the zoom level changes.

flipchange.description: Fired when the flip state changes.

cropchange.description: Fired when the crop area changes.

ids.description: The ids of the image cropper elements

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identify accessibility elements and their states.

initialCrop.description:
The initial rectangle of the crop area.
If not provided, a smart default will be computed based on viewport size and aspect ratio.

zoom.description: The controlled zoom level of the image.

rotation.description: The controlled rotation of the image in degrees (0 - 360).

flip.description: The controlled flip state of the image.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

zoomBy.description: Function to zoom the image by a relative amount.

rotateBy.description: Function to rotate the image by a relative amount in degrees.

flipHorizontally.description: Function to flip the image horizontally. Pass a boolean to set explicitly or omit to toggle.

flipVertically.description: Function to flip the image vertically. Pass a boolean to set explicitly or omit to toggle.

resize.description: Function to resize the crop area from a handle programmatically.

setCrop.description:
Function to set the crop area in viewport coordinates, constrained like `initialCrop`
(min/max size, aspect ratio and viewport bounds). Zoom, rotation, flip and pan are kept.
Does nothing when `fixedCropArea` is set or before the viewport is measured.

reset.description: Function to reset the cropper to its initial state.

axis.description: The axis of the grid lines to display
